FriendlyReminder.Content:
Friendly Reminder:
All models must be original (battery replacement allowed) and pass iTools/3uTools full green check with no pop-up alerts.
Devices with repaired motherboards or severely damaged devices are not accepted — please confirm the device condition in advance.
Prices are based on the date of receipt. Reconfirmation is required if the validity period is exceeded.

Refurbished: Excellent overall appearance; original casing and screen; fully functional.
Premium: Original condition; no dents on the frame, no scratches on the screen, minimal signs of use.
Minor Wear: Slight signs of use; small dents on the frame or minor scratches on the screen.
Major Wear: Noticeable signs of use; multiple dents on the frame or visible screen damage.
Testable Defect: Devices with screen explosion, display abnormalities, or other issues that can still be tested for a quote.
FriendlyReminder.NewContent:
Friendly Reminder:
Factory Sealed: Brand new, unopened, complete accessories, intact packaging, no activation record.
Quotation is for reference only. Final pricing will be based on inspection results. Valid on the date of receipt.
iTools/3uTools full green check with no pop-up alerts.
